vsam.why: base/cntl/adef121.jcl DEFINE2: DATA(... KEYS(21 0) RECORDSIZE(64 64)); the engine's facts do not read KEYS / RECORDSIZE inside the DATA component, so the case states them

scenarios.name: first-entry-inquire
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the map initialised and sent (ERASE), then the same task's RECEIVE (the operator's input): option 1 inquires endowment policy 5 of customer 3 (LINK LGIPOL01 -> LGIPDB01); the policy shown, RETURN TRANSID('SSP{n}') with COMM-AREA

scenarios.name: inquire
scenarios.why: option 1 on a returning task (EIBCALEN > 0: GO TO A-GAIN): endowment policy 4 of customer 8

scenarios.name: inquire-not-found
scenarios.why: option 1 for a policy the customer does not hold: LGIPDB01 sets CA-RETURN-CODE '01' -> NO-DATA ('No data was returned.'), ERROR-OUT sends the map and initialises the areas

scenarios.name: delete
scenarios.why: option 3: LINK LGDPOL01 (01DEND) deletes policy 5 of customer 3 (POLICY row, cascade, VSAM copy); the fields blanked, 'Endowment Policy Deleted', SEND MAP twice

scenarios.name: delete-fails
scenarios.why: option 3 with LGDPDB01's DELETE failing (SQLCODE -913): CA-RETURN-CODE '90' -> SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK, NO-DELETE; the back end LINKs LGSTSQ first, so the task is judged up to LGSTSQ's refused WRITEQ (X6) and the rest is not compared

scenarios.name: bad-option
scenarios.why: option '9': WHEN OTHER -- 'Please enter a valid option', the option field's length -1 (cursor), SEND MAP ... CURSOR

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: HANDLE AID CLEAR(CLEARIT) -- the map sent MAPONLY, RETURN TRANSID

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: PF3: HANDLE AID PF3(ENDIT) -- SEND TEXT 'Transaction ended' ERASE FREEKB, RETURN

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: ENTER with no input: the RECEIVE raises MAPFAIL, HANDLE CONDITION MAPFAIL(ENDIT)

scenarios.name: add
scenarios.why: option 2: LINK LGAPOL01 ('01AEND') adds a endowment policy for customer 3 (POLICY + its type's row, VSAM copy); the new numbers shown, 'New Endowment Policy Inserted'

scenarios.name: add-unknown-customer
scenarios.why: option 2 for customer 999, who does not exist: LGAPDB01's INSERT into POLICY breaks its foreign key (SQLCODE -530) -> CA-RETURN-CODE '70', SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK, NO-ADD 'Customer does not exist'; the back end LINKs LGSTSQ first, so the task is judged up to LGSTSQ's refused WRITEQ (X6) and the rest is not compared

scenarios.name: add-fails
scenarios.why: option 2 with LGAPDB01's INSERT into POLICY failing (SQLCODE -913): CA-RETURN-CODE '90', SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK, NO-ADD WHEN OTHER 'Error Adding ... Policy'; the back end LINKs LGSTSQ first, so the task is judged up to LGSTSQ's refused WRITEQ (X6) and the rest is not compared

scenarios.name: update
scenarios.why: option 4: inquire endowment policy 4 of customer 8 (LGIPOL01), SEND MAP, RECEIVE MAP again (the harness gives a task one input per map: the second RECEIVE reads the same fields), then LINK LGUPOL01 ('01UEND') with the fields typed and the inquiry's LASTCHANGED still in COMM-AREA: 'Endowment Policy Updated'

scenarios.name: update-not-found
scenarios.why: option 4 for a policy the customer does not hold: the inquiry returns '01' -> NO-DATA before any update

scenarios.name: update-fails
scenarios.why: option 4 with LGUPDB01's UPDATE of the type's table failing (SQLCODE -913): CA-RETURN-CODE non-zero -> NO-UPD 'Error Updating ... Policy'; the back end LINKs LGSTSQ first, so the task is judged up to LGSTSQ's refused WRITEQ (X6) and the rest is not compared

notes: GenApp's endowment policy test transaction (LGTESTP2, transid SSP2, BMS map SSMAPP2 of mapset SSMAP: the symbolic map is generated from base/src/ssmap.bms, @bms/SSMAP.cpy). A first task (EIBCALEN 0) sends the initialised map and RECEIVEs in the same task; a returning one (EIBCALEN > 0; the program has no DFHCOMMAREA, its own COMM-AREA goes back through RETURN TRANSID) goes straight to the RECEIVE. HANDLE AID CLEAR / PF3 and HANDLE CONDITION MAPFAIL are exercised; the option field picks inquire (1: LGIPOL01), add (2: LGAPOL01, a failure is SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK), delete (3: LGDPOL01), or inquire-then-update (4: LGIPOL01, SEND MAP, a second RECEIVE MAP -- the harness gives a task one input per map, so it reads the same fields -- then LGUPOL01). The case runs the whole chain in the task: the four front ends, their Db2 back ends, the VSAM services and LGSTSQ (twelve programs). The VSAM file is genapp-lgupdb01's; Db2 is db2cre.jcl's tables and rows. POLICY.LASTCHANGED, COMMERCIAL.REQUESTDATE and the COMMAREA's CA-LASTCHANGED are clock fields. Error paths in the back ends LINK LGSTSQ and are judged up to its refused WRITEQ (X6). Uncovered: IF CA-RETURN-CODE > 0 true after the add / delete / update LINKs, and NO-ADD / NO-DELETE / NO-UPD: every back-end failure LINKs LGSTSQ before it returns, and the task is judged up to LGSTSQ's refused WRITEQ (X6), so what follows is not compared or counted.
